verdict: Organic visibility is holding; overdue backend milestones are the priority now.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, Google Business Profile was the only active channel, producing a combined 385 actions — direction requests, web clicks, and calls — over 28 days. Advance Grinding Services led the group with GBP engagement up 31% week over week, while Forte Precision Metals and O'Hare Precision Metals both saw declines of 54% and 20% respectively, consistent with softer late-summer search demand rather than a structural problem. No paid campaigns ran during this window, so there is no paid pipeline cushioning the organic dip. The immediate focus is clearing a set of backend setup items — contact pulls, account reconciliation, and a web/SEO fix — that have been overdue since July and August; until those are resolved, outreach sequences and CRM automation cannot launch. Once those blockers are closed, outreach and deeper pipeline activity are next in the sequence.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three businesses in the last 28 days
week-over-week GBP engagement increase at Advance Grinding Services
overdue setup milestones being resolved now to unlock outreach and CRM automation

watch_item.issue: Six backend milestones — contact pulls, account deduplication, stub reconciliation, and the web/SEO root-cause fix — have passed their deadlines and are currently blocking outreach sequences and CRM automation from launching.
watch_item.fix: These items are being worked through in order of dependency; the contact pull and stub reconciliation are the immediate priority so downstream automation can begin on schedule by end of September.
